# hosttracker_monitor (Data Source)

Reads one monitor, by id or by a lookup that resolves to exactly one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By id.
data "hosttracker_monitor" "by_id" {
  id = "8e2d4c8b-7a41-4a2b-9d0e-2f3a5c6b7d8e"
}

# By the address it watches. The lookup must match exactly one monitor.
data "hosttracker_monitor" "by_url" {
  lookup_url = "https://example.com/"
}

# By display name, for a monitor created outside Terraform.
data "hosttracker_monitor" "by_name" {
  lookup_name = "Marketing site"
}

output "marketing_state" {
  value = data.hosttracker_monitor.by_url.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The monitor's id. Name it, or look the monitor up by `lookup_url` or `lookup_name`.
- `lookup_name` (String) Find the monitor by its display name, matched exactly. The lookup must resolve to exactly one monitor.
- `lookup_url` (String) Find the monitor by the address it watches, matched exactly. The lookup must resolve to exactly one monitor.

### Read-Only

- `created` (Number) When the monitor was created, in Unix seconds.
- `cron_schedule` (String) The cron expression, when the monitor is cron-scheduled.
- `effective_url` (String) The normalized address actually monitored.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The configured enablement flag.
- `full_log` (Boolean) Whether every check is recorded.
- `interval` (Number) The check interval, in seconds.
- `locations` (Attributes) Where the check runs from. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `name` (String) The display name.
- `open_stat` (Boolean) Whether the statistics are publicly readable.
- `recheck` (Attributes) The quorum rule applied before a failure concludes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recheck))
- `settings_json` (String) The monitor's whole settings object as JSON. Empty when the read did not ask for settings.
- `since` (Number) When the current state began, in Unix seconds.
- `sla_target` (Number) The uptime percentage the monitor is measured against.
- `state` (String) `up`, `down`, `paused` or `maintenance`.
- `tags` (Set of String) The monitor's tags.
- `type` (String) Which kind of check this is.
- `updated` (Number) The API's change marker, in Unix seconds.
- `url` (String) The address the check is aimed at, as it was written.

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `excluded_agents` (Set of String) Locations explicitly kept off this check.
- `fallback` (String) What happens when no chosen location is available.
- `pools` (Set of String) The monitoring-location pools.


<a id="nestedatt--recheck"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recheck`

Read-Only:

- `min_num_down` (Number) How many locations must report a failure.
- `strategy` (String) The quorum rule.
